purpose: Reference list of facility labels from the historical master plan. NOT geographic data: no coordinates, never merge into aiu-campus.geojson.
source_status: Page images inspected at 300 dpi (printed pages 4 and 6). Labels transcribed exactly as printed, including source spellings and spacing.
built_status_note: Presence in a 2020 master plan does not mean the facility is built or operational. All entries are UNCONFIRMED.
orientation_note: The plan has no scale bar and no north arrow. 'Top', 'left' etc. below refer to the page as printed only.
relative_arrangement: The site is a five-sided plot ringed by roads, with parking and landscaped strips around the edge.

West (left) side, top to bottom: International Law Studies / Business Administration; Computer Science and Engineering 1 (dark-blue cluster); Art & Design and Engineering 2 (light-blue block); Utility Building; female staff/postgrad and student accommodation; Faculty of Tourism and Hospitability near the bottom-left.
Top centre: Outdoor Theater (hatched), with University Management (red ring) beside it and Central Library & Students Facilities (orange courtyard) just to its lower right.

Right (east) of centre: Faculty of Pharmacy (upper right), then a yellow cluster for Sciences, Postgrad, Dentistry and Medical School; Dentistry Hospital and Indoor Sports Hall sit between that cluster and the hospital.
Lower right of centre: University Hospital, the largest building. Bottom: male staff/postgrad and student accommodation.
Several peach-coloured courtyard blocks in the middle of the plan have no label.
leader_line_caveat: Facilities were matched to blocks by following dotted leader lines in a 300 dpi raster of a low-resolution image. Where one leader serves two labels, or several labels point into one cluster, the split is not recoverable and is recorded as such.
